description: This file is a server-side entry point for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests and responses, server rendering using React, and conditional logic based on user agent detection for bots versus browsers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main server handler function that processes incoming requests, sets CORS headers, detects user agents, and delegates to bot or browser specific handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot user agents, streaming HTML content using React's server rendering API.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser user agents, streaming HTML content similarly to handleBotRequest.
